title: Cozy Christmas Gift Ideas: A Christmas Eve Soy Candle
text: A cream label with a little tree and the line 'the most magical night of the year.' This Christmas Eve candle comes in 4 oz and 9 oz amber jars, an easy gift for a friend, a coworker or a host, and it looks good on a mantel or a nightstand.

title: Quiet Night In Ideas: A Cozy Evening Checklist
text: Some nights the best plan is no plan. Cancel the thing, put your phone down, light a candle and let the evening be quiet. The A Quiet Evening soy candle has a receipt-style label that adds up to 'peace and quiet,' a good small gift for a homebody.

title: Gingerbread Candle: A Sweet Christmas Gift for Holiday Bakers
text: A little gingerbread house on a cream label, with the line 'sweet moments, warmer days.' The Gingerbread Season soy candle is an easy Christmas gift for anyone who bakes, decorates early or just likes a cozy kitchen. Available in 4 oz and 9 oz.

title: Best Friend Gift Ideas: A Candle for the Person Who Just Gets It
text: Some people just get it. This dark green soy candle is a thoughtful, slightly funny gift for your best friend, a roommate or the one who always answers your texts. Pair it with a handwritten note and you're done.

title: Promotion Gift Ideas: A Candle for a Coworker or Friend Who Earned It
text: Congratulating someone on a promotion should feel a little more personal than a gift card. This mustard-yellow soy candle says 'looks like it paid off' with a small ribbon on the label. A good gift for a coworker, a friend or yourself.

title: Cozy Winter Night Ideas: Winter Wonderland Snow Globe Candle
text: A snow globe on a teal label, a soft blanket and a candle you actually want to light. The Winter Wonderland soy candle is a quiet, cozy way to ease into the colder months, and it makes a nice gift for a friend or a host.

title: Romantic Gift Ideas for Her: A Candle for Your Favorite Person
text: 'You make ordinary days feel like the good ones.' That's the whole label. A simple gift for a girlfriend, a partner or a spouse when you want to say something sweet without the flowers. Soy wax in an amber jar, 4 oz or 9 oz.

title: Teacher Thank You Gift Ideas: A Simple Candle They'll Actually Use
text: 'You made it look easy. We know it wasn't.' A teacher appreciation candle that works for the holidays, an end-of-term thank you or a school year send-off. Soy wax, amber jar, and a label that says exactly the right thing.

title: Nutcracker Christmas Candle: Cozy Holiday Decor and Gift Idea
text: Season's Greetings, with a little nutcracker on the label and the line 'warm wishes and cozy moments.' It sits well on a mantel next to a few pinecones, and it works as a gift for a friend, a coworker or a neighbor. Soy wax, 4 oz and 9 oz.

title: Good Luck Gift Ideas: A Candle for a Friend Starting Something New
text: A four-leaf clover, a calm cream label and the line 'something good is coming.' A hopeful gift for a friend starting a new job, an exam, a move or just a rough week. Soy candle in an amber jar, 4 oz or 9 oz.

title: Cozy Homebody Ideas: Everything You Need for a Night In
text: For people who are happiest at home: a soft blanket, a book you've been meaning to start and a candle that says 'I have nothing to do tomorrow.' The Funny Introvert soy candle makes a fitting gift for the homebody in your life.

title: Christmas Gift Ideas for Her: Joy to the World Candle
text: A gold star, a red and white checkerboard border and the line 'let your heart be light.' The Joy to the World soy candle is a nice Christmas gift for a sister, a friend or a mom, and the 4 oz size is small enough for a stocking.

title: New Apartment Essentials: A Cozy Candle for Your First Place
text: 'The keys are yours. So is the quiet.' A housewarming gift for a friend moving into a first apartment, or for yourself on move-in day. Soy wax, amber glass, and a label that suits a bookshelf or a kitchen counter.

title: Cozy Winter Home Ideas: A Navy Let It Snow Candle
text: Navy label, tiny white snowflakes, a warm flame. The Let It Snow soy candle is made for cold evenings and early sunsets. Put it on a coffee table, a mantel or a nightstand, or wrap it up for someone who loves winter.

title: Funny Birthday Gift Ideas for a Friend Who Hates Getting Older
text: 'Older, yes. Wiser? Let's not rush it.' A funny birthday candle for the friend who's over the whole getting-older thing. Soy wax in an amber jar, with a label that makes the card optional.

title: Hostess Gift Ideas for the Holidays: Holly Jolly Christmas Candle
text: A little green holly tree on a cream label, with the line 'a little extra holiday cheer.' Bring it to a holiday dinner, a cookie swap or a neighbor's open house. Available in 4 oz and 9 oz amber jars.

title: Long Distance Friendship Gift Ideas: A Candle for the Friend You Miss
text: 'Different places. Same person I'd call first.' A thoughtful gift for a best friend who moved away, a college friend or anyone you wish lived closer. Soy wax, amber jar, and a label that says what a text can't.

title: Minimalist Christmas Decor Ideas: A Cream Merry Christmas Candle
text: If your Christmas decor leans simple, start with a candle. This one has a cream label, a little red bow and the line 'peace, joy, cozy moments.' It fits a small apartment shelf and doubles as a gift. Soy wax, 4 oz and 9 oz.

title: Evening Wind Down Routine: Simple Self Care Ideas After Work
text: A wind-down routine can be three small things: turn off the notifications, dim the lights, light a candle. The Relaxation soy candle has a pale blue label that reads 'nothing needs you right now,' which is the whole idea.

title: Romantic Christmas Gift Ideas: Under the Mistletoe Candle
text: A holly border, a cream label and the line 'a little Christmas romance.' The Under the Mistletoe soy candle is a sweet gift for a partner, a stocking filler or a date-night-in centerpiece. Available in 4 oz and 9 oz.

title: Slow Morning Routine Ideas: A Cozy Coffee Corner With a Candle
text: Coffee, a pastry, five quiet minutes before the day starts. The Good Morning soy candle has a sunny yellow label with a peach checkerboard that brightens a kitchen counter or a desk. A cheerful gift for an early riser.

title: Christmas Mantel and Shelf Decor: A Merry & Bright Candle
text: Red ribbon, cream label, a warm glow. The Merry & Bright soy candle looks right on a mantel, a bookshelf or a sideboard, and it doubles as a gift for the person who decorates before Thanksgiving.

title: Funny Graduation Gift Ideas: A Candle for the New Grad
text: 'You did it. Now go do something with it. No pressure.' A funny graduation gift for a college grad, a high school senior or anyone finishing a program this winter. Soy wax in an amber jar.

title: New Job Gift Ideas: A Candle to Celebrate a Fresh Start
text: 'New job. Same you. Bigger things ahead.' A minimalist gift for a friend, sibling or coworker starting something new. Soy candle in an amber glass jar, 4 oz or 9 oz.

title: Anniversary Gift Ideas for Him or Her: A Simple, Sweet Candle
text: 'Out of everyone I could have met, I'm glad it was you.' A quiet anniversary gift for a husband, a wife or a partner of any number of years. Soy wax in an amber jar, with roses and soft light in the background.

title: Funny Gifts for Dad Who Has Everything: A Candle He'll Keep
text: 'Turns out, you did know what you were doing. Most of the time.' A funny Christmas or birthday gift for a dad, stepdad or father-in-law who says he doesn't want anything. Soy wax in an amber jar.

title: Gifts for Dog Moms and Cat Moms: A Funny Pet Lover Candle
text: 'They shed. They judge. They run the place.' If you have a pet person on your list, this one's for them. A funny, cozy gift in a soy candle, shown here next to a paw-print bowl and a rope toy.

title: Stocking Stuffer Ideas: Mini Christmas Candles in Two Sizes
text: The Christmas Eve candle comes in a 4 oz mini and a 9 oz classic, so you can fill a stocking or wrap a bigger gift. Cream label, little tree, amber jar. A good one to buy a few of for coworkers, neighbors and friends.

title: Funny Retirement Gift Ideas for a Coworker or Boss
text: 'No meetings. No Mondays. No problem.' A funny retirement gift for a coworker, a boss or a parent who's finally done. Soy candle in an amber jar, easy to pass around the office card.

title: Self Care Gift Basket Ideas for Her: Simple and Cozy
text: A self care gift basket doesn't need much: a candle, fuzzy socks, a favorite tea and a good book. The Self Care Club soy candle has a rose label and a little checkerboard, and it's the one thing in the basket that starts the evening.
